test_title: PYST 36: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 28 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Kabir, Sumit, Ranvir, Madhu, Samir and Tanvi are sitting around a circle, facing the centre. Ranvir sits second to the right of Samir. Samir sits second to the right of Madhu. Sumit sits to the immediate left of Samir. Kabir sits second to the left of Tanvi. Who sits to the immediate right of Kabir?
solution: Given: Kabir, Sumit, Ranvir, Madhu, Samir and Tanvi are sitting around a circle, facing the centre. 2) Ranvir sits second to the right of Samir. 3) Samir sits second to the right of Madhu. 4) Sumit sits to the immediate left of Samir.
